actions.title: Reply to review: UC-1 Tests column left to the owner
actions.body:
Reply to the Reviewer's finding on head 7c2579b0805b8137255947d13a44dd246d517edf.

**Finding 1 (docs/use-cases.md, UC-1 Tests column): not changed here.** The repository's rules keep the use-cases file out of a change pull request, so I did not edit it. The owner should fill the Tests column of the UC-1 row with `test/sub.test.js`, which names UC-1 in all three of its tests. Nothing else in the code or tests changes.

**Checks in this run:** the gate (`node --test`) passes, 4 of 4 tests, including the three UC-1 tests in `test/sub.test.js` (`sub(5, 3)` is 2, `sub(3, 5)` is -2, `sub(0, 0)` is 0). No decision record is needed, so the ADRs column stays empty, as the use case says.

No new commit is made by this reply; the head stays at 7c2579b.
